title: The Path
author: Sanjay Das
stanzas: Walking on a path no one took,
Mile after mile, I went on
as far as the eye goes…
alone, all alone, I went on…

title: প্রাচীনের গৌরব
author: Sanjay Das
original_transliteration: tobo, bishal prasader, purbo diker chotto janalakhani, ashovon lage dekhia amake porda diyacho tani, Shirna bokhhe rugna panjare, dogdho go mor deha , charidike chai khujia na pai, dekhibe je more keha, // tobu dukho nahi mor, asha niye banchi snigdo batase swaopnete bivor, nobu ek gourabe adhitiya ami, a bishal shoudha maje, ushar prothom kiron khani hidoyete mor baje, provater lal roktim avay, panjorer more shotoal , swarna tama rongin hoye , nitya somujjol.

transcription_notes.shototal: শততল — author’s explicitly requested spelling: Shototol
